title: What happened after economies first crossed into upper middle income

metadata.revisionWarning: The 2025 values are estimates and may be revised.
metadata.rounding: Displayed values should be rounded; derived ratios retain one decimal place.
metadata.method: Among economies observed moving from low or lower middle income into upper middle or high income during 1987-2025, classify whether they ever returned below upper middle and whether they remained below in 2025.
metadata.warning: The workbook starts in 1987, so this covers observed transitions within the available history rather than every transition a country has ever made.
